question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

SEARCH ∶ ESRAHC ∶∶ DESIGN ∶ EDISNG ∶∶ LAYOUT ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**SEARCH ∶ ESRAHC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7522eccdd5dea1569824e78f631da3957972689bf875b29db615dff05b593dea.png] 

**DESIGN ∶ EDISNG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72566da500f751b7a7b505ee5c9f41f938bd991d5d9d282d5638e635ba331cba.png] 

Similarly,

**LAYOUT ∶ ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74d57a24cfc146652e2304902fb25a1132cecfc09c8de2b786ec2b7194e089e8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ALOYTU"**.
